title: A 24-hour refund window for clothing returns
summary: A return policy that stops use-and-return abuse without punishing honest customers.

story.intro: Clothing returns are being abused: some people wear an item and send it back for a full refund. Here is the problem, and how a 24-hour refund window fixes it.

problems.title: Use and return
problems.text: Customers wear an outfit to an event, then return it for a full refund.

problems.title: Sellers carry the loss
problems.text: A worn item can’t be resold, so the seller takes the hit.

problems.title: Honest customers pay for it
problems.text: Real problems, like a defect or the wrong item, get mixed up with abuse.

problems.title: No clock
problems.text: Nothing tells customers how long they have, so returns can come at any time.

solutions.title: 24-hour refund window
solutions.text: Refund or exchange is available for 24 hours after delivery, shown as a live countdown on the order.

solutions.title: Exchange only after 24 hours
solutions.text: Once the window closes, only an exchange is possible. No refund and no store credit.

solutions.title: Verified defect exception
solutions.text: Damaged, defective or wrong items stay refundable at any time, once the customer adds photos.

solutions.title: Clear return reasons
solutions.text: The return flow asks why, so the right rule applies and the seller learns what goes wrong.

title: AI GitHub Search: fresh, relevant repositories
summary: AI search finds relevant repositories that are years out of date. I defined the problem and designed freshness-aware ranking.

story.intro: AI search finds repositories that match your query, but many are years out of date. This case study adds freshness to the ranking, so people see repos that are still alive.
story.problemSub: What happens when search only looks at relevance and stars.
story.solutionSub: Tap a step to see it in the search on the right.
story.capProblem: Search that ranks by relevance and stars only.
story.capSolution: Tap each step to see how the results change.

problems.title: Relevant but outdated
problems.text: Results match the query, but haven’t been updated in years.

problems.title: Stars hide the age
problems.text: A high star count makes an old project look like a safe pick.

problems.title: Manual checking
problems.text: Users open several repos to check commits, releases and issues by hand.

problems.title: Beginners can’t tell
problems.text: Students and beginners can’t easily see whether a repo is still active.

solutions.title: Search in plain language
solutions.text: Describe what you need. Semantic search finds repos by meaning, not just keywords.

solutions.title: Rank by relevance and freshness
solutions.text: A simple, explainable score: relevance, language and requirement match, plus a maintenance signal.

solutions.title: Say why it was picked
solutions.text: Each result shows its reason, like a strong match and a recent update.

solutions.title: Filter by recency
solutions.text: Choose repos updated within 6 months, 1 year or 2 years.

title: EchoShield: detecting AI voice deepfakes
summary: A web platform that classifies audio as real or AI-generated, with a confidence score, in under a second.

story.intro: AI voice cloning makes fake audio sound real, and people can’t hear the difference. EchoShield is a web platform that checks whether an audio clip is real or AI-generated.
story.problemSub: Why AI voice cloning is a problem.
story.solutionSub: Tap a step to see it on the right.
story.capProblem: A cloned voice can sound real.
story.capSolution: Tap each step. Click the title or the button to open the live site.

problems.title: Cloned voices are used for fraud
problems.text: AI voice cloning is misused for fraud, impersonation and misinformation.

problems.title: People can’t hear the difference
problems.text: The manipulation is so subtle that humans struggle to tell real voices from AI-generated ones.

problems.title: No quick way to check
problems.text: Existing solutions lack real-time, user-friendly verification.

problems.title: Research doesn’t reach users
problems.text: Models struggle with unseen speakers and tools, mostly run offline, and rarely explain their predictions in an easy web interface.

solutions.title: Upload or record audio
solutions.text: Users add a file or record live in the browser. The audio is cleaned and standardized before analysis.

solutions.title: BiLSTM detection on MFCC features
solutions.text: A BiLSTM neural network trained on the SceneFake dataset reads MFCC features and classifies the audio as real or fake.

solutions.title: A confidence score in under a second
solutions.text: Results show real or fake with a confidence score. The model reached 93.8% accuracy, with an average processing time under 1 second.

solutions.title: Transcription and an AI assistant
solutions.text: Speech-to-text and a context-aware chatbot help users understand the result, and learn pages explain deepfakes.
